description: Defines structures and a parser for handling 'TalkDirective' JSON-based configuration blocks within text, including parsing and extracting directive parameters from input strings.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Represents a speech synthesis directive with various optional configuration parameters.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Contains the result of parsing a directive from text, including the directive object, the remaining text, and any unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Provides static methods to parse text into a TalkDirective object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string to extract a TalkDirective configuration and the remaining stripped text.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a string value for given keys from a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a Double value for given keys from a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve an Int value for given keys from a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a Boolean value for given keys from a JSON dictionary.
